answer: Registration binds each identity to one bonded hardware credential, a 400-unit stake, and a work-proof anchored to a device serial number registered at the local wharf. Minting N fakes locks 400×N units, slashes 100 percent of every stake on detection, and forces a 30-epoch wait. Copying identities multiplies marginal cost per fake across the shared penalty, and independent jurors cross-check device records against tundra and ferrous registry entries.
